title: 第1610章 元素泰坦与元素领域第1609章 谈判失败
content_zh:
黑暗巨人脚踏黑暗之海，头顶的天空也渐渐变暗，仿佛黑暗即将把整个世界都吞噬掉一般。
使用出八级战士的元素泰坦后，拜伦·廉德整个人皆化作了元素状态，与元素泰坦相融，此时的他就是元素泰坦，元素泰坦就是他。
于是拜伦·廉德半跪在黑暗之海上，两只手插入了其中，原本波涛汹涌的黑暗之海迅速恢复平静，然后他用尽全力，将脚下的黑暗之海撕开，捏在手中。
右手上的黑暗之海凝聚成了一柄黑暗长剑，左手上的黑暗之海化作了一张黑暗披风，拜伦·廉德左手一动，就将黑暗系了上去，然后他举剑指向了默里·格林。
“你想看我到底有多少底牌，那就得看你有多少本事了，来吧。”
说着拜伦·廉德直接就朝着默里·格林挥出手中黑暗长剑，巨大的黑暗长剑释放出一道遮天蔽日的黑暗剑芒，朝着默里·格林笼罩过去。
而此刻众人眼中皆是一片黑暗，再也看不到默里·格林的身影。
“如果你只拿出这点本事的话，那你就只能死在我手下了。”
面对拜伦·廉德如此凶猛的一剑，默里·格林脸上不仅没有露出害怕之色，反而有些遗憾，随后他用双手高举元老法杖，往下落去。
元老权杖落下时，在默里·格林脚下空间敲出了一道清脆的响声，仿佛一块巨石落入湖泊之中，道道空间涟漪出现，朝着四面八方传播出去。
在这个过程中，默里·格林的身体散发出大量灰色粒子，融入了空间涟漪之中，并且他的身体越来越淡，最后全部消失不见。
转瞬间，空间涟漪与黑暗剑芒接触到一起，在空间涟漪之下，黑暗剑芒被折成了无数段。
并且折断黑暗剑芒的空间涟漪没有停下，继续扩张，甚至是准备将拜伦·廉德也笼罩进去。
“好可怕的元素领域。”
看到空间涟漪不受阻拦的朝着自己袭来，拜伦·廉德瞳孔微缩，发出了一声惊叹，然后用黑暗披风将自己身体一裹，就化作一道黑色流光，以极快的速度往后逃去。
战士修炼到八级，元素化后，可以在体内蕴含海量战气，这是原本的战气海所无法比拟的。
因此当八级战士全力战斗时，原本的身体承受不住如此庞大的力量，所以就可以将其释放出来，与战气武装凝聚成元素泰坦，用以完全调动体内力量。
而魔法师晋升八级后，也同样拥有元素之躯，蕴含有庞大的魔力，所以当元素之躯与魔法领域融合时，便成为了元素领域。
元素泰坦这个个体可以看做其本身，那么元素领域也可以看做为魔法师的本身，元素领域就是魔法师，魔法师就是元素领域。
因此魔法师调动元素领域中的一切，就像是呼吸一般简单，不过越强大的魔法师，所融合出的元素领域，自然也更加强大。

拜伦·廉德不想在元素领域中战斗，所以往后逃跑，而默里·格林只是一个劲的向外扩张自己的元素领域。
将自己身躯与领域相融后，默里·格林有种很舒坦的感觉，就像是一个人，在憋屈的小房间里待久了，突然换到一个大庄园里面，那舒畅感简直无法形容。
在这一刻，默里·格林发现自己没了呼吸，心脏也没有再跳动，但他依旧能感觉到自己那强大的生命力和力量。
“这感觉真不错呀。”
不过当默里·格林的元素领域扩张到极限后，却发现自己的空间力量正在往领域之外流逝，准确的说，他正在给这个世界反馈空间力量。
这就像是两杯浓度不同的盐水倒进一个杯子里面，其中的浓度较高的盐水会变淡，而这个世界的空间魔法粒子较少，自然就会从默里·格林的领域中转移空间力量。
发现如此情况的默里·格林不由得嘴角一抽，忽然有种向五大元老说对不起的冲动。
难怪他们不想出现在外界，全力动手时，整个世界都在为难他们，这放谁身上都都受不了。
不过好在这种情况短时间内无法对默里·格林造成什么影响，所以他依旧可以全力战斗很长一段时间，将彻底解决掉。
于是他马上借助元素领域施展空间禁咒，元素领域在他的意念下，凭空生出了道道简单的纹路，然后不断朝着领域中央汇聚而来，快速形成了一个禁咒魔法阵雏形。
在源源不断的魔法纹路拼凑下，这个禁咒魔法阵雏形正以极快的速度变完整，当拜伦·廉德注意到这个情况时，这个禁咒魔法阵已经完成了一半。
“看来这元素领域拥有施法速度增幅的能力，不过这速度也太快了吧。”
此时就连拜伦·廉德都下意识的发出了一声惊呼，而外界观战的绝大多数都还没有反应过来这到底是怎么回事。
而看清楚情况的强者却已经哑口无言，根本不知道该如何形容眼前一幕，因为这施法速度完全超出了他们的认知。
要知道，默里·格林这是在准备一个禁咒，而禁咒的释放极其艰难，所以要很长的准备时间。
并且还要一气呵成的完成释放，中间要是耽搁或者被干扰一下，很可能前功尽弃。
结果默里·格林却借助自己的元素领域，将空间禁咒魔法阵拆分成大量简单的魔法纹路，然后将其拼接起来。
这给的感觉就像是大量魔法师，在一起完成一个魔法，但这种配合度，就算是三帝国的法师团也没法达到。
默里·格林仅仅只是一个人，却干出了一个法师团都望尘莫及的地步，看到这一幕的众势力主，心中对拜伦·廉德的信心不由得降低不少。
而拜伦·廉德的心也在一路下沉，同时回忆起默里·格林之前所说的话，自己再不掏出底牌来，真的要被他直接干死了。

想到这的拜伦·廉德，那股阴冷气息再次从他身上出现，不过这一次，他没有再收敛，反而将其完全爆发出来。
与此同时，黑暗巨人的身体也发生了改变，只见他的身体迅速膨胀起来，但好像只有骨架在长，肉量没有增加，使得他整体看起来反而越发削弱。
content_en:
The dark giant stepped on the sea of ​​darkness, and the sky above his head gradually darkened, as if darkness was about to swallow up the entire world.
After using the elemental titan of the eighth-level warrior, Byron Liande's entire body transformed into the elemental state and merged with the elemental titan. At this time, he was the elemental titan, and the elemental titan was him.
So Byron Lian De half-knelt on the Sea of ​​Darkness and inserted his two hands into it. The originally rough Sea of ​​Darkness quickly returned to calm. Then he used all his strength to tear open the Sea of ​​Darkness under his feet and hold it in his hands.
The sea of ​​darkness on his right hand condensed into a long sword of darkness, and the sea of ​​darkness on his left hand turned into a cloak of darkness. With a move of his left hand, Byron Lian tied the darkness on it, and then he raised his sword and pointed it at Murray Green.
"If you want to see how many cards I have, then you have to see how capable you are. Come on."
As he spoke, Byron Liande waved the dark sword in his hand directly towards Murray Green. The huge dark sword released a dark sword light that covered the sky and shrouded the sky towards Murray Green.
At this moment, everyone's eyes were filled with darkness, and Murray Green could no longer be seen.
"If you only show this little ability, then you will have no choice but to die at my hands."
Facing such a fierce sword from Byron Liande, Murray Green not only did not show fear on his face, but also felt a little regretful. Then he raised the elder's staff with both hands and dropped it.
When the elder's scepter fell, there was a crisp sound in the space under Murray Green's feet, as if a huge boulder had fallen into a lake, and ripples in the space appeared and spread in all directions.
During this process, Murray Green's body emitted a large number of gray particles, which merged into the ripples of space. His body became lighter and lighter, and finally disappeared.
In an instant, the space ripples came into contact with the dark sword light. Under the space ripples, the dark sword light was broken into countless segments.
And the space ripples that broke the dark sword light did not stop and continued to expand, even preparing to envelope Byron Lian De.
"What a terrifying elemental realm."
Seeing the space ripples heading towards him unimpeded, Byron Liande's pupils shrank and he let out an exclamation. Then he wrapped his body in a dark cloak and turned into a stream of black light, running away at an extremely fast speed.
When a warrior reaches the eighth level in cultivation and becomes elemental, he can contain a massive amount of fighting energy within his body, which is unmatched by the original sea of ​​fighting energy.
Therefore, when an eighth-level warrior fights with all his strength, his original body cannot withstand such a huge force, so he can release it and condense it with the battle energy weapon to form an elemental titan, which can fully mobilize the power in his body.
After the magician reaches the eighth level, he also has an elemental body, which contains huge magic power. Therefore, when the elemental body is integrated with the magic field, it becomes the elemental field.
The individual elemental titan can be regarded as itself, then the elemental field can also be regarded as the magician itself. The elemental field is the magician, and the magician is the elemental field.
Therefore, a magician can mobilize everything in the elemental realm as easily as breathing. However, the more powerful the magician is, the more powerful the elemental realm he fuses will naturally be.
Byron Lian De didn't want to fight in the elemental realm, so he ran away, while Murray Green just kept expanding his elemental realm outwards.
After integrating his body with the realm, Murray Green felt a very comfortable feeling, just like a person who had stayed in a small, uncomfortable room for a long time and suddenly moved to a large manor. The feeling of comfort was simply indescribable.
At this moment, Murray Green found that he was no longer breathing and his heart was no longer beating, but he could still feel his powerful vitality and strength.
"This feels really good."
But when Murray Green's elemental realm expanded to the extremeAfter the limit, he found that his space power was flowing out of the field. To be precise, he was feeding back space power to the world.
It's like pouring two glasses of salt water with different concentrations into a cup. The salt water with higher concentration will become lighter, and there are fewer space magic particles in this world, which will naturally transfer the space power from Murray Green's domain.
When Murray Green discovered such a situation, he couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth, and suddenly felt the urge to say sorry to the five elders.
No wonder they don't want to appear in the outside world. When they go all out, the whole world is making things difficult for them, which no one can bear.
Fortunately, this situation will not have any impact on Murray Green in a short period of time, so he can still fight with all his strength for a long time and completely solve it.
So he immediately used the elemental field to cast the space forbidden spell. Under his thoughts, the elemental field produced simple lines out of thin air, and then continued to converge towards the center of the field, quickly forming a prototype of the forbidden spell magic array.
With the continuous piecing together of magic lines, the prototype of the Forbidden Curse Magic Array was becoming complete at an extremely fast speed. When Byron Lian De noticed this situation, the Forbidden Curse Magic Array was already half complete.
"It seems that this elemental field has the ability to increase the casting speed, but this speed is too fast."
At this time, even Byron Lian De subconsciously exclaimed, but most of the people watching the battle had not yet realized what was going on.
But the strong men who saw the situation clearly were speechless and didn't know how to describe the scene in front of them, because the casting speed was completely beyond their understanding.
You know, Murray Green is preparing a forbidden spell, and the release of the forbidden spell is extremely difficult, so it takes a long time to prepare.
Moreover, the release must be completed in one go. If there is any delay or interference in the process, all previous efforts may be wasted.
As a result, Murray Green used his elemental field to split the space forbidden spell magic array into a large number of simple magic lines, and then spliced ​​them together.
This feels like a large number of magicians working together to complete a magic, but this level of coordination cannot be achieved even by the mages of the Three Empires.
Murray Green is just one person, but he has achieved something that even a group of mages can't match. Seeing this scene, all the power leaders couldn't help but lose a lot of confidence in Byron Lian De.
And Byron Liande's heart was also sinking all the way. At the same time, he recalled what Murray Green said before. If he didn't show his trump card, he would really kill him.
When Byron Liande thought of this, the cold aura appeared from his body again, but this time, he did not restrain it anymore, but completely exploded it.
At the same time, the Dark Giant's body also changed. His body expanded rapidly, but it seemed that only the skeleton was growing, and the amount of meat did not increase, making him look weaker overall.
